title: Cloud Advisory
lead: Strategic advice on cloud adoption, governance and optimisation — helping organisations make informed, value-driven cloud decisions.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Cloud Advisory provides independent, expert guidance on cloud strategy, architecture and governance. It covers the full cloud journey — from initial strategy and business case through architecture design, migration planning and ongoing optimisation. Cloud Advisory is vendor-agnostic and focuses on what is right for the client's specific context.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: Cloud Advisory is a strategic service that informs the platform dimension of the IT Operating Model. It ensures cloud decisions are aligned with business strategy, operating model requirements and governance constraints — rather than driven by technology preference or vendor pressure.

items.desc: Defining the cloud adoption approach, principles and target architecture.
Designing cloud landing zones, reference architectures and integration patterns.
Objective assessment and selection of cloud providers and managed service partners.
Cloud governance policies, cost management and security controls.
Ongoing cost, performance and security optimisation of the cloud estate.
